```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/gallery.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: about-hero
tags$div(
  class = "about-container",

  # ── Banner image ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$img(
    src   = picsum_url("auggie-about", 1720L, 968L),
    class = "about-hero-img",
    alt   = "Auggie Smith with camera in the field"
  ),

  # ── Bio ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$h2("About"),
  tags$p(
    "I\u2019m Auggie Smith, a high school photographer based in Oak Park, Illinois,",
    "just outside Chicago. I picked up my first camera a couple of years ago",
    "and haven\u2019t put it down since."
  ),
  tags$p(
    "Chicago gives me an endless canvas \u2014 the architecture, the lakefront,",
    "the neighborhoods, the people. Oak Park adds a quieter counterpoint:",
    "tree-lined streets, Frank Lloyd Wright rooflines, and the kind of",
    "everyday moments that are easy to walk past if you\u2019re not paying",
    "attention. I\u2019m still learning how to see, and that\u2019s the part I love most."
  ),
  tags$p(
    "Right now I\u2019m especially interested in macro work \u2014 getting close enough",
    "to a subject that the familiar becomes strange. I\u2019m also drawn to wide",
    "environmental shots that put a person or object in context with the",
    "world around it. Both feel like opposite ends of the same question:",
    "how much do you show, and how much do you leave out?"
  ),

  # ── Milestones ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$h2("Milestones"),
  {
    milestones <- list(
      list(year = 2025, item = "Oak Park Township Youth Arts Showcase \u2014 Photography category"),
      list(year = 2025, item = "Oak Park & River Forest High School Photography Club \u2014 member"),
      list(year = 2024, item = "Chicago Botanic Garden student photo walk \u2014 selected participant"),
      list(year = 2024, item = "First macro series \u2014 \u201cClose\u201d \u2014 shared on Instagram")
    )
    items <- lapply(milestones, function(m) {
      tags$li(
        tags$strong(m$year),
        HTML(paste0(" &nbsp;\u2014&nbsp; ", m$item))
      )
    })
    do.call(tags$ul, items)
  },

  # ── Approach ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$h2("Approach"),
  tags$p(
    "I shoot mostly natural light. I\u2019m still figuring out my editing style,",
    "but I tend to pull back on heavy processing \u2014 I\u2019d rather the image look",
    "like something that actually happened. The best photos I\u2019ve taken were",
    "accidents I almost deleted."
  ),

  # ── Equipment ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$h2("Equipment"),
  {
    gear <- c(
      "Fujifilm X-T5",
      "Canon EOS R50",
      "Macro lens \u2014 for close-up and detail work",
      "Wide angle lens \u2014 for architecture, landscapes, and environmental portraits"
    )
    items <- lapply(gear, tags$li)
    do.call(tags$ul, items)
  },

  tags$hr(),

  # ── CTA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$div(
    style = "text-align:center; margin-top:2rem;",
    tags$a(href = "contact.html", class = "btn-photo btn-photo-muted", "Get in Touch")
  )
)
```
